stem:
Calcium nitrate, $\text{Ca(NO}_3\text{)}_2$, reacts with ammonia, carbon dioxide and water to form a mixture of ammonium nitrate and calcium carbonate.

$$\text{Ca(NO}_3\text{)}_2 + 2\text{NH}_3 + \text{CO}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow 2\text{NH}_4\text{NO}_3 + \text{CaCO}_3$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain why ammonia is described as a Brønsted-Lowry base in this reaction.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The product mixture can then be added to soil.

State **two** reasons why this mixture of products is added to some soils.

parts.label: (c)
